title: Import intent without assuming a generic importer
when: When adopting external issues/documents or changing an item specification after intake.
need: Identify supported intake and typed artifact writes; preserve source provenance and existing IDs, duplicate checks, readiness and current evidence. Do not infer bulk-item import support from universe import.
surface: Idea intake/refine; typed structured fields; readiness adapters
gap: Help advertises item writes/search, but this pass did not verify a general item import or arbitrary attachment facility. Review question: what adoption formats and evidence links are actually supported, and which need instructions rather than new import code?
